## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete problem and what changes for users. Link an issue when relevant.

## Validation

List commands and results, plus MacBook model/chip and macOS version for hardware checks. State anything untested.

## AI assistance and provenance

State `None` or name tools, affected areas, and how you reviewed and validated their output. Credit sources and retain required notices. Do not include private prompts or credentials.

## Checklist

- [ ] I understand the change and have the right to contribute it under the project license.
- [ ] I ran relevant checks and reported their real results.
- [ ] I considered pause, reopening, stale readings, sleep, and Reduce Motion where relevant.
- [ ] I updated relevant docs and included no personal data, secrets, or build artifacts.
